head.text: PROPOSED (changes.md CS2): IDE register read, base window (PIO mode 0), 10-clock cycle

signal.name: state
signal.data: S0 S1 S2 Sw Sw Sw Sw Sw Sw Sw Sw Sw Sw Sw Sw Sw Sw S3 S4 S5 S0 S1

foot.text: Proposed. Drawn at 16 MHz (1 slot = 15.6 ns). DEVMAP's thermometer counter steps on each falling edge after AS. nIDE_RD_INH is low for the first clock and again from T8, and BUSCTRL's nCPU_RD flop samples it on falling edges, so /IOR is low from edge 2 to edge 9: 437 ns at 16 MHz. DEVMAP acknowledges at T7, so the CPU sees DSACK1 on edge 8 and latches the data on edge 9, the same edge that ends /IOR. The IDEH flop keeps /CS0 asserted until the next rising edge, after /IOR has risen, while the data transceivers turn off with AS. A fast-window read (0x4000_0800) uses the same logic with T3 and T2 for a 5-clock cycle.
